goal: Name the single most valuable improvement EXCAVA could make to how it presents results to its owner, and say concretely what to change.

judge.said:
ARTIFACT 2
The winner is more concrete and actionable because it provides specific revisions (e.g., dynamic summaries, user-defined priorities) rather than general suggestions.

artifacts.solo: The single most valuable improvement EXCAVA could make is to provide more concise and prioritized summaries of its findings. Currently, EXCAVA may present a large volume of information, making it difficult for its owner to quickly identify the most important results.
